subject: Ensino Religioso
description_pt: Identificar mitos de criação em diferentes culturas e tradições religiosas.

components.description_pt: Identificar mitos de criação presentes em diferentes culturas e tradições religiosas
components.description_en: Identify creation myths present in different cultures and religious traditions
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a modern fiction author adapts source material from myths, religious texts, or traditional stories

components.description_pt: Distinguir características de mitos de criação entre duas ou mais tradições religiosas
components.description_en: Distinguish features of creation myths across two or more religious traditions
components.cc_component_description: Compare the organizational structures used across two or more literary texts

components.description_pt: Reconhecer mitos de criação como expressões narrativas de cosmovisões culturais diversas
components.description_en: Recognize creation myths as narrative expressions of diverse cultural worldviews
components.cc_component_description: Compare the treatment of similar themes across stories or myths from different cultures

cc_matches.description: Analyze how a modern work of fiction draws on themes, patterns of events, or character types from myths, traditional stories, or religious works such as the Bible, including describing how the material is rendered new.
Compare and contrast the structure of two or more texts and analyze how the differing structure of each text contributes to its meaning and style.

Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.
